Third-party notices

Four skills are adaptations, not unchanged upstream releases:

  • grill-me: Matt Pocock's grill-me and grilling, copyright (c) 2026 Matt Pocock. MIT notice.
  • test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, and verification-before-completion: Superpowers, copyright (c) 2025 Jesse Vincent. MIT notice accompanies each skill.

sources.json records immutable upstream revisions, original file SHA-256 hashes, local destinations, and adaptations. Original-source hashes intentionally do not equal adapted local-file hashes. npm run verify:sources checks those public source hashes over the network without uploading workspace files.

The adapters are self-contained: upstream helper links were replaced by concise local procedures, not left dangling. No plugin hooks, shell utilities, or external agents are bundled. Preserve each license file when copying an adapted skill.

The other eight skills are original lab material. This notice does not impose a new license on the rest of the workspace. Check the owning project's redistribution terms before republishing original material.

GIF encoding is adapted from this workspace's existing AI-slop capture tooling. npm development dependencies retain their own licenses in their installed distributions and lockfile metadata.

Source: skills/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md

Walkthroughs and studio scenes are illustrative, not recorded Copilot output. Only the Commands lab GIFs show real check results, re-run by the recorder before each capture. No productivity statistics are claimed.
